title: eludite.browser.dialog input
x-eludite-escalates: Dangerous when a file is outside the workspace folder.
description: Answer the dialog a tab's page is waiting on (default: the active tab): a JavaScript `alert`, `confirm` or `prompt`, a `beforeunload` confirmation, a file chooser, an authentication challenge, or a permission prompt. While one is open the page is paused, so an eludite.browser.input that opened one answers it as `dialog: {kind, message}` instead of waiting. `accept` is OK (confirm, prompt with `text`, leave the page, choose `files`, sign in with `username` and `password`, allow the permission); `dismiss` is Cancel (stay, no files, deny). The person sees the same dialog in the Web Browser window and may answer first; then this call fails with "no dialog is open". Files outside the workspace make the call dangerous, which prompts (as eludite.browser.upload). Permission class execute. Next: eludite.browser.read_page or screenshot to see what the page did.

text.description: `prompt` with `accept`: the text to answer (default: the prompt's default text).

files.description: `file` with `accept`: absolute paths, as eludite.browser.upload takes.

password.description: `auth` with `accept`. Like every argument of an agent's call, it is kept in the audit log.

tab.description: The tab: its id from eludite.browser.tabs (`t1`, `t2`, ...). Default: the active tab (the one last opened or selected).
